title: add warning about restarting the session
description:
Adds the following at the beginning of each accompanying `.Rmd`:

``` 
If you have been running other tidymodels articles in this project, restart R before working on this article so you don't run out of memory on RStudio Cloud.
```

title: Scale to cloud
description:
This PR reduces example data size to avoid aborting and spend less time for computations. It also includes text to explain why these steps had to be taken.

- Article 2: Only 20% of the original data set is used.
- Article 5: Only 25% of the original data set is used and for random forest tuning grid size has ben reduced to 12. Currently tuning computation is a little over 2 mins.

title: Add README.Rmd with easy open code chunks
description:
The new README.Rmd:
1. suggests saving a permanent copy if user would like to save their changes.
2. provides two options to get started: open file or run dedicated code chunk 
3. Code chunk opens website in viewer pane and .Rmd file
-- Maybe ignore README.md on the cloud side?

Changes to other .Rmd files:
"click on the link" instructions changed to "visit the links provided'
